subject.title: [Feature]: Faster default STT path on CPU-only hosts (65s clip took ~6 min with whisper turbo)

question: Should OpenClaw change its CPU-only automatic STT default beyond the existing ready-sherpa-first fallback, and if so, what quality, installation, and remote-provider tradeoff is acceptable?
rationale: Current main already offers provider routing, acceleration-aware local ordering, and explicit model overrides, but it does not establish a universal safe model-download or duration-based policy for CPU-only hosts.

options.title: Retain current defaults and document tuning
options.body: Keep the ready-backend ordering and direct CPU-only operators to explicit faster provider or CLI model entries.

options.title: Sponsor a benchmarked CPU-default policy
options.body: Define a supported cross-platform CPU backend and quality floor, then adjust automatic ordering only when that backend is ready.

options.title: Add an opt-in low-latency mode
options.body: Expose a clearly documented mode only if maintainers want speed-over-quality behavior without changing existing automatic defaults.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a benchmarked CPU-default policy
recommendation.body: Define a supported cross-platform CPU backend and quality floor, then adjust automatic ordering only when that backend is ready.

likelyOwner.reason: The related acceleration-selection design establishes the relevant backend-evidence and explicit-override boundary.
